REPORT
Date August 8, 1938.
Subject Secret National Salvation Organization in Sze Wee (四維)
Elementary Middle School off Yenping Road, O.O.L.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa. Forwarded by C. Crawford
Information has been received that a national salvation
organization entitled "The Shanghai Municipality Youths
Progressive Society (少年界進修会)" has been recently establish-
ed in the Sze Wee Elementary Middle School, off Yenping Road,
about 20 yards from Yenping Road, O.O.L. It is sponsored
by one named Jui (瞿 ).
It is a secret organization, and persons will be granted
membership only upon the recommendation of two members and
after due investigation of their standing. This society
maintains connections with a number of other national salvation
organizations. The members are supplied with national
salvation publications such as "Unity", etc. by Jui (瞿 )
who is believed to be one of those responsible for the
publication of such literature.
CHINA

报告
日期：1938年8月8日。
主题：关于延平路（O.O.L.）四维小学内秘密救国组织的报告。
由侦探员顾宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa）撰写。由 C. Crawford 转呈。
据获情报，一个名为“上海市少年界进修会”的救国组织最近在位于延平路（O.O.L.）旁、距延平路约20码的四维小学内成立。该组织由一名姓瞿（Jui）的人发起。
这是一个秘密组织，只有经两名会员推荐并经过对其背景的适当调查后，方可获得会员资格。该社与多个其他救国组织保持联系。会员们由瞿（Jui）提供《团结》等救国刊物，据信瞿是负责出版此类文献的人员之一。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. 8700
S.1, Special Branch. Station,
REPORT
Date August 24, 19 38.
Subject Meeting in the Jen Wu (人和) Primary School, Lane 310, 3
Ayburgh Road - banned by Police.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. LOGAN

In connection with the proposal of the Shanghai
Municipality Youths' Progressive Society to hold a meeting
in the Jen Wu Primary School at 2 p.m. on August 21 (vide
attached Special Branch report), members of Special Branch
with the assistance of detectives attached to Sinza Station
visited the above mentioned address at 2.15 p.m. August
21. On arrival at the school premises twelve persons of
the student type were found gathered in an upstairs room
of the school and upon being questioned, they stated that
they were waiting the arrival of one named Tseong (生重),
who would give them a lecture dealing with modern science.
They further stated that they were students of various
schools and that during the current summer vacation they
often gathered in the above school with a view to furthering
their studies. They pleaded ignorance of the particulars
of the organization of the above mentioned Society.

Papers etc. found in the possession of the
attending persons were examined and found to contain
nothing of an objectionable nature. The assembled students
were subsequently dispersed after having been cautioned
against holding any meeting without first having obtained
permission from the Police.

Mr. Liu Don Ho (劉敦厚), teacher of the Jen
Wu Primary School, was likewise cautioned.

Police Members attending :-
D.S. Marsden and C.D.S. 67 (Sinza Station).
D.S. Hide and Inspector Shi'h San Chien (Special Br.)

报告
日期：1938年8月24日。
主题：爱文义路3号310弄人和小学内的集会——被警方禁止。
由高级侦探督察洛根（LOGAN）撰写并转呈

鉴于上海市少年界进修会提议于8月21日下午2时在人和小学举行会议（参见附上的特别支部报告），特别支部成员在辛扎巡捕房（Sinza Station）附属侦探的协助下，于8月21日下午2时15分前往上述地址。到达学校场地时，发现12名具有学生特征的人聚集在学校楼上的一个房间里，经询问，他们称正在等待一位名叫生重（Tseong，音译）的人，此人将为他们讲授有关现代科学的课程。他们还称自己是各校的学生，在当前暑假期间，他们经常在上述学校聚会，以增进学业。他们辩称对该社的组织细节一无所知。

对在场人员随身携带的文件等物品进行了检查，未发现任何违禁内容。随后，在对这些聚集的学生发出警告，指出在未事先获得警方许可的情况下不得举行任何集会后，将他们驱散。

人和小学教师刘敦厚（Liu Don Ho）也受到了警告。

出席警务人员：
警佐马尔斯登（Marsden）和辛扎巡捕房第67号华人高级侦探。
警佐海德（Hide）和特别支部施三坚（Shi'h San Chien，音译）巡官
wlogan

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No........... 8666/5700
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date August 19, 1938.

Subject The Shanghai Municipality Youths' Progressive Society
(上海市少年界進修會) - Proposed Meeting.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to Special Branch report dated
August 8, 1938, on the subject of the formation of a
secret national salvation organization entitled "The
Shanghai Municipality Youths' Progressive Society" in the
Sze Wee (四維) Elementary Middle School off Yenping Road,
O.O.L., it is now learned that the Society has issued a
notification to its members inviting them to attend a
lecture on arts to be delivered by one Mr. Tsoong Yih
Ming (鐘一鳴), at the request of the society, in the
Jen Woo (人和) Primary School, Lane 310, 3 Myburgh Road,
at 2 p.m. August 21. A copy of the notification is
attached hereto.

Although the society claims that its aims are
"to improve the youths both intellectually and morally
and also to serve the people and the country," both of
which do not appear to be objectionable, confidential
information on hand indicates that the principal object
of the society is to promote propaganda of a national
salvation and/or anti-Japanese nature and that the Society
has connections with other similar organizations. It is
therefore surmised that politics might possibly be touched
upon in the lecture to be given on August 21 in the Jen
Woo Primary School, Lane 310, 3 Myburgh Road.

报告
日期：1938年8月19日。

主题：上海市少年界进修会——拟议中的会议。
由侦探员顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）撰写 [签名] 转呈

参照1938年8月8日关于在延平路（O.O.L.）旁四维小学成立名为“上海市少年界进修会”的秘密救国组织的特别支部报告，现获悉该社已向其会员发出通知，邀请他们参加由钟一鸣（Tsoong Yih Ming）先生应本社请求所作的艺术讲座，地点为爱文义路3号310弄人和小学，时间为8月21日下午2时。通知副本附后。

虽然该社声称其宗旨是“在智力和道德上提升青年，并为人民和国家服务”，这两点看似并无不妥，但手头的情报显示，该社的主要目的是推广救国和/或反日性质的宣传，并且该社与其他类似组织有联系。因此推测，8月21日在爱文义路3号310弄人和小学举行的讲座中可能会涉及政治内容。
